styles.pixel: Style: authentic pixel art made of crisp hard-edged square pixels on a perfectly regular grid, limited palette, flat color fills with 3-4 shades per material, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no blur, no noise, no dithering. Playful, bright retro eighties office pixel art with its own original look: warm cream walls (#f4ecd8) with bold geometric patterns of triangles, circles, zigzags, black squiggles (#262626) and confetti dots, a light speckled terrazzo floor, teal (#2fb5a6) desks and sofas, bubblegum pink (#f07aa8) and sunny yellow (#f6c945) accents, lavender (#a593e0) and coral (#ef8354) details, glass block partitions, glowing teal monitor screens, potted cacti and palms. Original artwork: do not copy or imitate any existing game, tileset or artist. Outlines in dark blue-grey (#2b3245), never pure black. Light comes from the top-left. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos or watermark.
styles.chroma: Background: one perfectly flat solid magenta color (#FF00FF) filling the entire background edge to edge, with no shadow, no floor, no gradient, no vignette and nothing else. The subject is isolated, centered, with a generous margin, and must not contain any magenta or pink.
styles.wallart: Style: a bold, simple illustration that will be displayed TINY as a framed picture on an office wall in a pixel art game (smaller than 64 pixels wide). Use large flat areas of strong saturated color, high contrast between neighbouring shapes, chunky iconic shapes and very few details; no thin lines, no small text. The artwork must fill the ENTIRE wide canvas edge to edge (full bleed), with no white or empty margins and no letterboxing: no frame, no border, no wall, no mat, no signature, no letters.
styles.poster: Style: a bold minimalist graphic poster that will be displayed TINY (about 12x16 pixels) on an office wall in a pixel art game. One single big iconic subject centered and filling most of the canvas, on a solid flat background color; strong saturated colors, high contrast, chunky simple shapes, no small details, no thin lines. Fill the whole canvas edge to edge: no frame, no border, no wall, no text, no letters, no numbers.

assets.prompt: A pixel art game icon of a charming little modern office building, designed to stay crisp as a tiny app icon. It is drawn on a coarse grid of big square pixels (the building is about 60 pixels wide and 70 pixels tall), every pixel exactly the same size and perfectly aligned to the grid, shown enlarged. Strictly front-facing elevation, as building sprites in classic top-down RPG and management games: perfectly straight vertical walls and horizontal edges, no perspective, no vanishing point, no slanted or diagonal lines, no side wall. A flat teal-blue roof seen from above as a simple rectangle with a light rim and straight vertical sides (not a trapezoid), directly on top of the facade, with one small potted plant on it. Light warm-grey facade with two honey-wood horizontal bands between the floors. Three floors with three big simple windows each: one solid flat color per window inside a dark frame, glowing warm yellow (two of them glowing bright blue like computer screens), with no mullions, no panes, no curtains and nothing drawn inside. A glass double door with a small teal awning in the middle of the ground floor. Only the building: nothing on the ground around it (no furniture, no sofas, no extra plants, no people). Simple, bold, symmetrical, cute; a compact rectangular silhouette, a bit taller than wide, that fills most of the square.

A pixel art scene of a cheerful, empty retro eighties office interior in the afternoon, in top-down 3/4 view like a cozy management game. A light speckled terrazzo floor; two islands of teal desks with glowing teal monitors, keyboards and mugs, pink office chairs pushed in; a lounge corner with a curvy yellow sofa, pink and teal cushions and a round rug with black squiggles; potted cacti and palms in yellow and pink pots; tall shelves with colorful binders; a water cooler with a teal jug; a small coffee counter; a glass block partition. Big windows along the back wall show a bright sky with a few clouds. Cream walls decorated with big triangles, circles and zigzags. Bright, playful, inviting atmosphere, nobody there: no people, no characters, no animals. Keep it simple: big flat shapes, few details.
